messages:
amar: Hey team — PR #18902 is green locally but CI is stuck in 'cached build warmup' for the linux-matrix job. Need a rebase window before tomorrow's deploy freeze. Who can give quick eyes? @jess @samir

jess: On it, will trigger a rerun. do we need a rebase or is it probably just cache priming?

samir: Likely cache. saw a flaky cache key mismatch last week. If rerun doesn't help we should rebase to pick up the bazelrc fix.

amar: CI job shows `waiting for cached artifacts...` in the logs. Rerun scheduled? @ci-bot

ci-bot: release CI: Rerun requested by jess for PR #18902. Queue position: 4. ETA ~12m :hourglass_flowing_sand:

maria: If rerun still fails, can we ask infra to evict the stale cache for linux-matrix? @lee

samir: Agree. Also reminder we have a rebase window 10:30–11:30 PT. If rerun fails and infra can't evict quickly we'll rebase during the window.

jess: Rerun started. I'll ping again in 15.

amar: Also FYI this PR touches edge routing; prefer to land pre-freeze if possible — rebase is fine but want minimal churn for canaries.

ci-bot: release CI: Rerun for PR #18902 job linux-matrix: failed (cache warmup timeout). Logs: `ERROR: failed to fetch remote cache`

jess: That failed. Samir — want me to rebase and push or do you want to handle the rebase?

samir: I can take the rebase. Will rebase onto main and push a small no-op to bump CI: `git rebase --onto origin/main` then push. If infra can evict cache that'd be faster.

maria: Filed infra ticket INF-4723 to evict cache; assigned to @lee. ETA 20m.

lee: lee: saw INF-4723, working on clearing the cache for linux-matrix buckets. ETA 10–15.

amar: :thumbsup: Thanks. If lee clears cache and jess re-runs we can probably land before 11:30. Otherwise we'll use the rebase window.

jess: Started new rerun after cache clear.

ci-bot: release CI: linux-matrix job for PR #18902: success ✅

jess: Green! @amar want me to merge when you have approvals?

amar: I have two approvals but need one more from product-review. @maria can you quick-approve?

maria: Quick read done, LGTM for release. approving now.

amar: Thanks. Merging in 5m unless objections.

samir: No objections. Good call on evicting the cache.

ci-bot: release CI: merge initiated for PR #18902 by amar

amar: Merged. Thanks y'all. I'll follow up post-deploy if anything pops.

jess: :party-parrot: Nice work. Marking as landed pre-freeze.
